snippet.title: Fold'Em - Itchio Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
SpookySnuffy presents a sinister high stakes poker game, Fold'Em. Face off against Creeps as your survive, Cheat and discover more about why you ended up here in the first place.

Fold'Em is in active development and now available to try on Itchi.io! Steam Launch expected 2027.
